inventory.quote: This chapter discusses the following topics related to Visa fleet card processing:
This section discusses the following processing requirements for the Visa fleet card:
The following BIN’s within the specified Visa purchasing card BIN range are reserved for Visa fleet cards:
The POS/CAT device must support a magnetic stripe reader capable of reading Track 1 and Track 2 data.
The POS application must be able to read the corresponding Card Type code sent in the table load.
In the case where an application does not process a table load from BUYPASS, the application must provide a method to determine whether Visa fleet cards are allowed.
The following transactions are supported for the Visa fleet card:
In order for BUYPASS to receive Visa fleet card transactions, the Merchant Profile’s credit option must be activated.
Please refer to the applicable message format specifications for information about valid Prompt Codes for the Visa fleet card.
If it is required, the Driver ID can have a length of 1– 6 digits. It should be unencrypted in the message format for BUYPASS.
The device must interpret the value in the Service Prompt field of the magnetic stripe to determine whether a Driver ID is required.
Manual entry is allowed on a Visa fleet card transaction.
If unable to read the magnetic stripe after three attempts, the device should prompt for manual entry of the 16-digit Visa fleet card Account Number and prompt for an ID and the odometer reading.
Note: If manual entry is used, this fact is indicated on the receipt and journal by an asterisk (*) before the Account Number.
The device performs expiration date validation in a Visa fleet card transaction.
The Visa fleet card expiration date is suppressed on the cardholder receipt.
Note: For all authorizations, merchants must send a value even for expired cards.
For Visa fleet cards, a Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation is performed on the full Account Number.
If it is required, the odometer reading can have a length of 1–8 digits.
If it is required, the Vehicle Number can have a length of 1–6 digits.
An authorization signature is not required for any Vehicle Number prompt.
The device must interpret the value of the Service Enhancement Indicator
Note: A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.
For a Visa Fleet Card transaction, the merchant must be able to provide the correct enhanced data information to the processor.
Note: A Fleet Card transaction must comply with Fleet data requirements, in order to be eligible for reduced commercial interchange rates, such as Commercial Level II or Level III.
The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions. The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.
The default track that is sent to BUYPASS on an original transaction should be Track 2.
Card data provided in a follow-on transaction must be partial Track 2 Data.
Note: This does not apply to the TransArmor-VeriFone Edition processing when sending full Track 2 Data.
This section discusses the following card layout for the Visa fleet card:
The following table describes Track 1 data layout information for the Visa fleet card:
Note: The device should not transmit the Start Sentinel in any transaction.
Visa fleet cards are required to use the last three positions of this field to provide instructions for customized prompts.

Note: Field Nos. 1, 8, and 9 are not sent in online messages; however, they are necessary for magnetic stripe reading devices.
